title: First-Line Supervisors of Security Workers
description: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of security workers and security guards.

tasks.text: Investigate disturbances on the premises, such as security alarms, altercations, and suspicious activity.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI can triage alarms; human verifies and responds physically

tasks.text: Patrol the premises to prevent or detect intrusion, protect property, or preserve order.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Security/safety walkthrough requires physical presence

dwas.name: Inspect facilities to ensure compliance with security or safety regulations.

tasks.text: Monitor and authorize entry of employees, visitors, or other persons.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Managing physical flow of people needs on-site presence

dwas.name: Monitor access or flow of people to prevent problems.
Prevent unauthorized individuals from entering restricted areas.

tasks.text: Secure entrances and exits by locking doors and gates.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically blocking access to areas

dwas.name: Block physical access to restricted areas.

tasks.text: Write reports documenting observations made while on patrol.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Incident reports drafted from facts; human reviews

tasks.text: Monitor the behavior of security employees to ensure adherence to quality standards, deadlines, or procedures.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — AI reviews logs; human observes operations on site

dwas.name: Monitor operations to ensure compliance with safety or security policies or regulations.

tasks.text: Advise employees in handling problems or resolving complaints from customers, tenants, detainees, or other persons.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Cross-staff problem resolution involves politics and trust

dwas.name: Communicate with management or other staff to resolve problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Recruit, interview, and hire security personnel.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — AI drafts outreach; human builds candidate relationships

tasks.text: Assign security personnel to posts or patrols.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Assignments drafted; accountability and negotiation human

dwas.name: Assign duties or work schedules to employees.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Call police or fire departments in cases of emergency, such as fire, bomb threats, and presence of unauthorized persons.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Emergency request requires live accountable action

dwas.name: Request emergency personnel.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Apprehend or evict trespassers, rule violators, or other security threats from the premises.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical security presence in world

tasks.text: Screen individuals and belongings to prevent passage of prohibited materials using walkthrough detectors, wands, or bag searches.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Surveillance monitoring partly AI, physical setup human

dwas.name: Search individuals for illegal or dangerous items.
Operate surveillance equipment to detect suspicious or illegal activities.

tasks.text: Monitor closed-circuit television cameras.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — AI can watch camera feeds; human maintains physical surveillance

dwas.name: Maintain surveillance of individuals or establishments.
Operate surveillance equipment to detect suspicious or illegal activities.

tasks.text: Inspect and adjust security equipment to ensure it is operational or to detect evidence of tampering.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Surveillance monitoring partly AI, physical setup human

dwas.name: Inspect equipment to ensure safety or proper functioning.
Operate surveillance equipment to detect suspicious or illegal activities.

tasks.text: Train security personnel on protective procedures, first aid, fire safety, and other duties.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Training content AI-assisted; live instruction and demonstration human

dwas.name: Train personnel to enhance job skills.
Conduct health or safety training programs.

tasks.text: Explain company policies and procedures to staff using oral or written communication.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI explains policies; human handles live questions

dwas.name: Explain regulations, policies, or procedures.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Develop and document security procedures, policies, or standards.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Document routine operational activities from inputs

tasks.text: Schedule training or drills for emergencies, such as fires, bombs, and other threats.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI builds instructional schedules; human adjusts

tasks.text: Log items distributed to persons, such as keys and key cards.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

tasks.text: Write and present department budgets to upper management or other stakeholders.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Reports and budgets drafted; human owns assumptions

dwas.name: Prepare financial documents, reports, or budgets.
Report information to managers or other personnel.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Order materials or supplies, such as keys, uniforms, and badges.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend
